units.source_text: 薰中纳言风度之优美，令人看了自感惭愧。

en.t: The elegance of Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was so refined that anyone who saw him felt humbled by comparison.

units.source_text: 许久不见，越发漂亮，容光焕发，动人心目。

en.t: After so long apart, he had grown still more handsome, radiant and deeply captivating.

units.source_text: 丰采与众不同，啊呀，何等可喜的人儿啊！

en.t: His bearing was unlike anyone else's; ah, what a delightful person he was!

units.source_text: 二女公子看见了他，竟回想起片刻不忘的亡姐的面影来，不胜悲伤。

en.t: When the Second Princess saw him, she unexpectedly recalled the face of her late elder sister, whom she had never forgotten for a moment, and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言对她说道：“我对令姐的怀念，一言难尽。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said to her, "My longing for your sister cannot be expressed in a single word.

units.source_text: 惟今日乃乔迁之喜，自应忌讳。”便不谈大女公子之事。

en.t: But today is the happy day of your move, so such matters should naturally be avoided." Thus he did not speak of the elder princess.

units.source_text: 接着说道：“今后不久，我即将迁往小姐新居附近。

en.t: He continued, "Before long, I shall move near your new residence.

units.source_text: 世人说起亲近，有‘不避夜半与破晓’之谚。

en.t: When people speak of closeness, there is a saying that one does not avoid either midnight or daybreak.

units.source_text: 小姐今后无论何时有何需要，务请随意吩咐，不可客气。

en.t: From now on, whenever you need anything at all, please command me freely and do not stand on ceremony.

units.source_text: 我只要生存于世，无不竭诚效劳。

en.t: So long as I remain in this world, I will serve you with all sincerity.
I do not know what you think of this.

units.source_text: 世间人心种种不同，小姐得不视此言为唐突乎？

en.t: Since people's hearts differ in many ways, might you perhaps find these words too forward?
I myself would not dare to presume."

units.source_text: 二女公子答道：“我实在不想离开这故居。

en.t: The Second Princess answered, "I truly do not wish to leave this old home.

units.source_text: 你虽说迁往我新居附近，但我心绪缭乱，无言可以奉告。”

en.t: Although you say you will move near my new residence, my heart is in such confusion that I have no words to offer you."

units.source_text: 她说时每一句话尾音消失，态度非常可怜，与大女公子十分肖似。

en.t: As she spoke, the end of each sentence faded away; her manner was deeply pitiful and very much resembled that of the elder princess.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想道：“我自心没有主意，致使此人为他人所得。”

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought, "Because I had no resolve of my own, I let this person become someone else's."

units.source_text: 非常后悔，然已无可奈何，便不提那一夜之事，装作忘记的模样，泰然坐着。

en.t: He regretted it bitterly, but there was nothing to be done now, so he did not mention that night and sat calmly, pretending to have forgotten it.
